bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (local store), springboard/src/shell/services/contacts.rs (contacts service: access, fetch, save), springboard/sdk/src/contacts.rs (SDK), springboard/apps/contacts-desktop (Contacts app), springboard/src/shell/quicksearch.rs (search index), springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs (vCard export)
summary: BifrOSt has a shell-internal local contact store (one flat file, fixed fields, atomic save) that the Contacts app, Search and Share use directly. Apps read and save contacts through the SDK contacts module and the contacts service, behind a per-app access grant. No groups, containers or change history exists. Apps with a contacts read grant get system.contacts.change when the store file changes.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (load, load_checked, save), springboard/src/shell/services/contacts.rs (contacts service), springboard/sdk/src/contacts.rs (access, request, fetch, save)
features.note: The store is a shell module, which the Contacts app reaches by crate path (springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs:26). Load, checked load, atomic save and the per-app grant that gates the service are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs. Apps reach the store only through the contacts service and the SDK contacts module, and the store file itself is not visible to apps.

features.apple: Accessing the contact store; NSContactsUsageDescription; contact access button and picker
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_access.rs (Access, Status, Choice, Access::request, change_in_settings, can_read, check_write); springboard/sdk/src/contacts.rs (access, request, decode_status, decode_picked, preview)
features.note: Four-state model per app (not determined, denied, authorized, limited read-only) plus the system restriction; the prompt is answered once, and change_in_settings covers later changes. Verified headless by the headless_* tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs. The SDK request only reports the status, the shell sets grants, the access sheet and Settings row are not built, and grants reset on restart.

Fixed fields: name, phone, email, notes, company, address, favorite, and three label indexes; the display name, initials and validity rules are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs. The SDK and the `contacts` service return labeled multi-values (phones, emails, URLs as label/value/identifier), a birthday and labeled dates from a sidecar file (springboard/src/shell/contactextras.rs), tested there too; the Contacts app still edits one phone, one email and one address. No relations, social profiles, instant messages, images or nickname. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Multi-values are SDK-side only; verify on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_fetch.rs (LabeledValue, LabeledValue::numbered, LABEL_HOME, LABEL_WORK, LABEL_OTHER, LABEL_PHONE_MOBILE, LABEL_PHONE_MAIN); springboard/sdk/src/contacts.rs (decode_contacts labeled entries)
features.note: Labeled entries carry a label, value and identifier numbered from 1, with the fixed English labels home, work, other, mobile and main; custom labels are kept as plain text and no label is localized. Verified headless by the headless_labeled_values_* and headless_predefined_labels_* tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs. The Contacts app still edits one value per property, and the shell label indexes are not covered by these tests.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_fetch.rs (project, Keys, Partial::get, Partial::text), springboard/sdk/src/contacts.rs (fetch, decode_contacts)
features.note: The contacts service returns each record with only the keys the app asked for, and fetch takes an optional query over any text of the contact. Reading a field that was not fetched is a typed error (Error::NotFetched), verified headless by the headless_* tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs. Not yet tested on Midget. Search covers name, phone, email, notes, company and address.

Apps add, update and delete contacts in one save call through the contacts service and the SDK. Full access only: a limited grant is read-only. The whole call applies or none of it does, which springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs checks through apply_save; the store is rewritten atomically only on success. No per-record change history.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_changes.rs, springboard/ui/src/contact_groups.rs, springboard/ui/src/vcard.rs; wired: springboard/ui/src/contact_groups.rs (wired in springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs and group_file.rs)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. One flat list with no groups, containers or subgroups. Contacts keeps a lists sidebar in the app, but it has no group data behind it. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: CNChangeHistoryFetchRequest, CNChangeHistoryEvent family, CNChangeHistoryEventVisitor, Contacts changed notifications
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No change log: the shell posts system.contacts.change to apps with contacts access when the store file changes, not per-record events. Search results are rebuilt from the store when the file is loaded.

features.apple: Spotlight-style indexing of contacts (no direct CNContact symbol)
features.note: Shell Search returns contacts from the store. Apps index their own content through the SDK quicksearch module, which the contact store does not use.

features.apple: Contact access button, Contact access picker (sample code)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_access.rs (access model, wired in springboard/src/shell/services/contacts.rs); springboard/ui/src/contact_picker.rs (wired: Add People picker in springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs, Picker at line 1063)
features.note: The Contacts app uses the picker model for its Add People flow. No SDK picker lets an app ask the user to choose a contact and receive the result, so that part is still missing. Not yet tested on the VM or Midget.

Apps get a typed ContactsError from the SDK for access, read-only and access-model failures; the mapping from shell messages and access errors is tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03b.rs. The store still reports fixed io text for file-level failures (invalid contact, file too large, unknown format). The CNErrorCode raw values are not mapped: they are not verified against Apple's reference, so apps match on the variant.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs:Contact.notes (MAX_NOTES 4000); springboard/ui/src/contact_photo.rs (Photos: the picture model, not stored by the shell yet); PHOTO output in springboard/ui/src/contact_vcard.rs. Thumbnail is not serialized.
features.note: Notes are plain text with a 4000-character limit, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs, with no entitlement. The UI kit has a picture model (PNG and JPEG detection, size cap, thumbnail fit), but the shell does not store pictures yet, so the Contacts app keeps no contact photo or thumbnail.

gaps: Single-valued fields only: one phone, one email, one address. No birthday, dates, relations, social profiles, instant messages, URLs or photos.
No access sheet or Settings row for contact access; the shell sets grants, and they reset on restart.
No vCard in the SDK: apps cannot parse or build vCards. Import and export live in the Contacts app (springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/exchange.rs).
Every fetch reads the whole store file (cap 10,000 contacts, 8 MiB file) before the service filters it.
